name: Name of the electrode contact point
x: X position. The position of the center the electrode in xyz space in millimeters
y: Y position. The position of the center the electrode in xyz space in millimeters
z: Z position. The position of the center the electrode in xyz space in millimeters
size: Surface area of the electrode, in mm^2
